## Why This Is Asked
Tests for offline sync and conflict resolution are common in fintech and media apps; this checks practical thinking beyond basic unit tests.

- Sync strategies (last-write-wins, timestamps)

- End-to-end tooling (MSW, Playwright)
- CI simulation of offline/online

## Code Example
```javascript
function resolveConflict(local, remote) {
  // last-write-wins by timestamp
  if ((local.updatedAt || 0) > (remote.updatedAt || 0)) return local;
  return remote;
}
```

- Fast feedback loops with Jest/Vitest

- Target 80%+ code coverage

- Test database interactions

- Consumer-driven contracts with Pact

- Automated verification in CI

### Performance Testing
- Load testing with k6
- Stress testing scenarios
- Capacity planning benchmarks

### Chaos Engineering
- Simulate failures with Gremlin
- Test recovery mechanisms
- Improve system resilience

## CI/CD Optimization

- Parallel test execution
- Test result caching
- Smart test selection based on code changes
- Comprehensive monitoring and alerting
